summary: NewcelX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a $1.4 million private placement equity financing priced at a 20% premium to the last closing price. The company is selling 347,134 common shares at $4.033 per share and warrants to purchase the same number of shares at $4.437 per share. The offering includes existing shareholder participation and is expected to close around August 14, 2026. Proceeds will support its Type 1 diabetes program and working capital. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
